source_title: United Spirits Q2 profit falls 8% to Rs 428 cr - The Times of India
source_excerpt: BENGALURU: Diageo-controlled United Spirits reported a 7.8% decline in net profit to Rs 428 crore in the September quarter from Rs 464 crore a year earlier, with a larger loss in its sports business accounting for most of the fall.Total income declined 2.7% to Rs 7,079 crore from Rs 7,276 crore. Revenue from operations, which includes excise duty, fell 2.6% to Rs 7,014 crore.Profit from continuing operations declined 1.5% to Rs 460 crore. The sports business, classified as discontinued operations ahead of its proposed sale, reported a net loss of Rs 32 crore against Rs 3 crore a year earlier.On a standalone basis, net profit fell 2.1% to Rs 462 crore from Rs 472 crore. Net sales value, which excludes excise duty, rose 2.8% to Rs 3,258 crore, even as sales volumes declined 5% to about 15.8 million cases.Standalone advertising and sales promotion spending increased 57% to Rs 378 crore from Rs 241 crore. The company said it invested in brands and new launches ahead of the festive season. Marketing spending accounted for 11.6% of net sales, compared with 7.6% a year earlier.Net sales in the higher-priced Prestige & Above portfolio grew 6.3% to Rs 3,065 crore, accounting for 94.1% of standalone net sales. Volumes in the segment declined 1.2%.
